scripts.dev: pnpm --filter ecommerce vite & pnpm --filter assistant vite
scripts.build: pnpm --filter ecommerce vite build && pnpm --filter assistant vite build
scripts.type-check: pnpm --filter ecommerce tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter assistant tsc --noEmit
scripts.type-check:all: pnpm --filter ecommerce tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter ecommerce tsc --noEmit --project tsconfig.test.json && pnpm --filter assistant tsc --noEmit
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter ecommerce eslint assets/ts/**/*.ts && pnpm --filter assistant eslint src
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm --filter ecommerce eslint assets/ts/**/*.ts --fix && pnpm --filter assistant eslint src --fix
scripts.lint:all: pnpm --filter ecommerce eslint assets/ts/**/*.ts tests/vitest/**/*.ts && pnpm --filter assistant eslint src
scripts.lint:all:fix: pnpm --filter ecommerce eslint assets/ts/**/*.ts tests/vitest/**/*.ts --fix && pnpm --filter assistant eslint src --fix
scripts.lint:report: pnpm --filter ecommerce eslint assets/ts/**/*.ts tests/vitest/**/*.ts --format json --output-file var/tools/eslint/report.json || true && pnpm --filter assistant eslint src --format json --output-file reports/eslint.report.json || true
scripts.prettier:fix: pnpm --filter ecommerce prettier --write "assets/ts/**/*.ts" && pnpm --filter assistant prettier --write "src/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}"
scripts.prettier:all:fix: pnpm --filter ecommerce prettier --write "assets/ts/**/*.ts" "tests/vitest/**/*.ts" && pnpm --filter assistant prettier --write "src/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}"
